edits.value_json: "火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. 字源 p. 885 says the oracle-bone occurrence may refer to 火星 but does not specify 心宿二 or the planet Mars; the university lexicon explains 火星 here as the historical name for 大火/心宿二 (Antares). The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火."

"The star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. 字源 p. 885 says the oracle-bone occurrence may refer to 火星 but does not specify 心宿二 or the planet Mars; the university lexicon explains 火星 here as the historical name for 大火/心宿二 (Antares). The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火 or how its name relates to ‘fire’."
